WITH mt_dedup AS (
  SELECT m_transaction_id, state, dt
  FROM (
    SELECT
      m_transaction_id,
      state,
      dt,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m_transaction_id ORDER BY dt DESC, last_update DESC) AS rn
    FROM wish.master_merchant_transactions
    WHERE dt >= '2025-01-01'
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', CAST(dt AS date)) AS order_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN state = 5 THEN m_transaction_id END) AS refunded_transactions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m_transaction_id) AS total_orders
  FROM mt_dedup
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT order_month, refunded_transactions, total_orders, refund_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    0 AS sort_key,
    'ALL_PERIOD' AS order_month,
    SUM(refunded_transactions) AS refunded_transactions,
    SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders,
    CAST(SUM(refunded_transactions) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(total_orders), 0) AS refund_rate
  FROM monthly
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_key,
    CAST(order_month AS VARCHAR) AS order_month,
    refunded_transactions,
    total_orders,
    CAST(refunded_transactions AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(total_orders, 0) AS refund_rate
  FROM monthly
)
ORDER BY sort_key, order_month
